args.query: FBI violent crime offenses by state

sql: SELECT "year", offense_code, SUM(offense_rate) r, SUM(national_offense_rate) nat FROM crime.cde_offenses WHERE state_abbr='MI' AND offense_code IN ('homicide','robbery','violent-crime') AND "year" IN ('2015','2018','2019','2021','2025') GROUP BY "year", offense_code ORDER BY offense_code, "year"
